Subject: Azure Partner Center referral mapping & seller alignment — sync proposal

Hi Sara / Pete / Connor,

Thanks again for taking time last week on the Marketplace onboarding call. Per that conversation Contoso is set to flow Partner Center referrals to Redwood for the North American field, and Microsoft will route co-sell leads into the Partner Center workflow. To avoid duplicated outreach and to ensure the right seller gets assigned in HubSpot, I put together a lightweight proposal and an initial seed file attached.

High-level ask:
- Align on a single canonical "referral owner" mapping between Contoso account IDs and Microsoft seller IDs (Partner Center).
- Define a fallthrough rule when multiple sellers claim an account (priority: Contoso NAM owner -> MS seller mapped by PC -> Redwood AE fallback).
- Establish a weekly reconciliation process (CSV sync + delta review) to keep mappings fresh.

What I attached:
- referral_mapping_seed.csv — proposed account->PC-seller mapping for 150 pilot accounts
- seller_roster_q4.xlsx — suggested seller assignments for NA region (includes seller emails and MPN IDs)

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick validation by Contoso Sales Ops on the seed mapping (Sara) — accept / annotate rows that need reassignment.
2) Microsoft confirms the Partner Center seller IDs and any constraints (Pete).
3) Redwood (Connor + me) will wire a HubSpot import job and a weekly delta report; we'll share the import template and a sample reconciliation script.
4) Kickoff: 30-minute alignment call this week to lock the final mapping and the weekly SLA.

Can you confirm availability tomorrow 10/6 between 10:00–12:00 PT, or Wednesday 10/7 between 13:00–15:00 PT?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz

Folks — adding a few implementation notes from the Redwood side before the call:
- HubSpot mapping: we will use a custom "pc_seller_id" property on accounts and a timestamped "pc_mapping_source" to note origin (Contoso / PC export / manual). That helps audit who last changed the mapping.
- Importing: we'll run an upsert by external_account_id and write the previous owner to a secondary property to preserve history.
- Automation: propose a weekly scheduled job (Sunday 02:00 PT) that diffs the latest Partner Center export against HubSpot and emails a delta CSV to the reconciliation owner.
- Security/compliance: we'll only keep the minimal fields in Redwood logs; account IDs will be hashed in the weekly report. If Contoso requires raw IDs in SFTP, we can do that under a separate agreement.

Connor — can you please prepare the import template and the sample diff script for tomorrow's call?

Quick note on ownership conflicts: from experience with other PC co-sell pilots, two things to add to the playbook:
1) Tie-breaker: if Contoso and PC both claim a seller for the same account, prefer Contoso's explicit nomination if they provide a ticket/ops note within 48 hours; otherwise accept PC's mapping for outreach to avoid duplicate touch.
2) Escalation path: maintain an "ops-escalation" email alias and a monthly 30-minute sync for sticky accounts. Keep the first month as daily triage for the pilot cohort.

Also, we should flag any accounts currently in active renewals — those should be excluded from automatic reassignment unless both sides confirm. I can run a quick filter on the seed file and tag renewals.
